newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Corp seeking joint venture in China.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Corp seeking joint venture in China.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp said on Wednesday that it is seeking an approval from the Chinese government to set up a joint venture trading firm in Shanghai.

A Mitsubishi spokesman told Reuters that the leading Japanese trading company had hoped to win an approval from Chinese authorities much earlier than April, but that he now did not have any likely timing for getting the approval.
He said the company could not disclose any further details of the planned joint venture, which would be the first such project by a Japanese firm, until it was approved by China.
